method.scope: Exactly the 316 consumed prior partial-edit inputs. New representations of already exposed clips.
method.geometry: Use the exact prior 20 cells and original sample timeline. Frame features may use wider context.
method.flanks: Cell means at offsets (-3,-2) and (+2,+3), clipping indices to the first or last cell.
method.local: Subtract the average of the two flanks, then use the same 32 fixed signed projection coordinates for every layer.
method.boundary: For each layer retain relative squared distances from the center to each flank, between flanks, the minimum center-to-flank distance, the center-to-mean-flank distance, and mean immediate-neighbor distance.
method.fit: Reuse the unpaired overlap-weighted L2 linear objective. Fit only the prior 72 mixed and dry splice-triple views from eight fitting hosts.
method.point: Strict maximum of every genuine score in the independent operating-point role. No fit or point updates after scoring diagnostic or held roles.
method.location: Prior strongest 0.6-second span, exact interval IoU >= 0.30 and edit coverage >= 0.50. Report threshold-free span and oracle ordering separately.
method.primary: Layer boundary head must add at least two useful -5 dB views from two families over the unrefitted incumbent frame baseline, lose no dry useful view, add at most one false pair and flag no background-only control.
method.interpretation: All arms, including a successful primary, are diagnostic. Confirmation on other sources is required.
